parameters.name: EndpointID
parameters.description: The unique USP identifier for this USP Agent.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The Message Transfer Protocol (MTP) to be used for communications by a USP Endpoint. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.17 version.

parameters.name: DeploymentUnitRef
parameters.description: {{reference|the {{object|##.SoftwareModules.DeploymentUnit.}} object instance that this USP Service is part of.}} {{empty}} means that USP service doesn't have a corresponding software module.

parameters.name: ExecutionUnitRef
parameters.description: {{reference|the {{object|##.SoftwareModules.ExecutionUnit.}} object instance that this USP Service is part of.}} {{empty}} means that USP service doesn't have a corresponding software module.

parameters.name: HasController
parameters.description: The USP service has controller functionality next to the standard USP Agent functionality.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to a USPService configuration.
